scripts.jobs:status: docker compose -p famsync-local -f compose.local.yml exec -T database psql -X -U supabase_admin -d postgres -c "select kind, status, count(*) as jobs, max(attempts) as max_attempts from app.outbox group by kind, status order by kind, status" -c "select id, kind, attempts, request_id, left(last_error, 80) as last_error, finished_at from app.outbox where status = 'dead' order by finished_at desc limit 20"
